instruction: Replace direct depends_on labeling with deterministic transitive dependency traversal, define cycle and missing-node handling, validate closure for terminal leaves, and add nested-graph positive and negative regressions before rerunning the focused evaluator suite and ci:contract.

findings.summary: Dependency closure treats every direct dependency as a leaf and never traverses nested dependencies, so the packet can omit unfinished or unqualified terminal leaves behind an aggregate dependency.

evidence_refs.section: buildDependencyClosure derives declaredLeafIds directly from opts.task.depends_on and validates only those tasks
Plan and Verify Steps require per-leaf dependency closure and closure-completeness regression coverage
